title: Crown Prince Hans-Adam's Armageddon agenda, 1994 meeting

tellings.quote: is that we want the public to hate the aliens so bad that we can have an interplanetary war so that we'll have Armageddon. So Christ will return. I'm quoting.

plain: At a 1994 meeting at the Pierre Hotel in New York, Hans-Adam, then Crown Prince of Liechtenstein, is said to have explained a plan to make the public hate aliens so much that an interplanetary war would follow, bringing Armageddon so that Christ would return. The UFO researcher Steven Greer says he was there, and he presents the words as a direct quote; his account also names Laurance Rockefeller, Budd Hopkins, John Mack and David Jacobs. If true, it would mean powerful people wanted to steer public fear of aliens toward a religious end.
